title: Metallic bonding
caption: A metal is a lattice of positive ions in a sea of delocalised electrons. The attraction between the ions and the electrons is the metallic bond; the mobile electrons carry charge and heat, and layers can slide without breaking it.
alt: A grid of sodium ions with free electrons scattered between them.
description: Rows of Na⁺ ions in a regular lattice.
Small dots between them: the delocalised electrons, free to move.
